title: A viral Chinese app called "Are You Dead?" that asks users living alone to "check in" with a button press becomes the top paid app in Apple's App Store in China (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: A viral Chinese app called “Are You Dead?” that asks users living alone to “check in” with a button press becomes the top paid app in Apple's App Store in China — Popularity among Chinese Apple users highlights concerns created by rapidly changing demographics
contentText:
Financial Times :

A viral Chinese app called “Are You Dead?” that asks users living alone to “check in” with a button press becomes the top paid app in Apple's App Store in China   —  Popularity among Chinese Apple users highlights concerns created by rapidly changing demographics
